Tool names here are Academic Harness's own. In Claude Code, `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## Reference library

`reference_library` is the reference manager (PaperMemory's library for this workspace): one tool with an `action` (`list get resolve import export tag collection note keys dedupe merge doctor set_integrity`). `import` takes BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS (from EndNote, Scopus, Web of Science, publishers) or CSL-JSON; `list`/`get`/`resolve` find papers by key, DOI or filters (`tag:ml year:2020..2024 has:pdf !tag:skip words`); `tag`, `collection` and `note` organise them; `export` writes BibTeX/BibLaTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON/JSON/CSV, or keeps a project `.bib` in sync.
- Cite only keys the library or `papermemory_cite` returns; never invent or "tidy" a key. Search results flagged `in_library` are already stored: do not add them again.
- Paths are relative to the session workspace and cannot leave it; you never pass a directory. To write or refresh a project bibliography use `export` with `cited_only: <manuscript>` (or a project-bound `collection`) and an `out` path; run it with `check: true` first on an existing file and tell the user if it reports `hand_edited` or `not_managed` — use `force` or `adopt` only when the user asks (a backup is kept).
- A `collection` carries the project it was created under: `export` uses that project's own versions and keys even when you give an explicit `out`. Pass `project` to override; a collection with no project uses canonical keys.
- A key is stable once exported. Change one only with `keys` `rekey`: the dry run lists the manuscripts that cite it; applying needs a reason from the user; the old key keeps resolving.
- `dedupe` and `merge` never act alone. Show the field-level preview and wait for the user before `apply`. Titles that differ only by a part number, a year in a series, or "Addendum/Erratum" are different records.
- `doctor` reports evidence. A paper never integrity-checked is unknown, not clean: run `integrity_check` with `library` to check and record retractions, and surface any retracted or corrected paper a manuscript still cites.

If the MCP tools are absent (startup failure is loud; the tools disappear), the `papermemory` CLI is the fallback (`papermemory recap --json`, …). Do not `pip install` a second copy; the plugin manages `~/.dsh/papermemory`.
